title: Signs (Keystones)
description: Signs determine the FORM in which the sigil's element manifests. SVG in viewBox '-50 -50 100 100', drawn in canonical orientation (pointing toward the center/inward where applicable). 'invertible' = can be flipped for the opposite effect. 'canBeCenter' = can occupy the center in place of a sigil. 'surrounds' = must encircle the central sigil. Each sign carries 'origin' (provenance: where the data came from — 'wiki' = obtained from telepedia's Signs Explained, fan-curated from canon; 'canon' = straight from the manga/anime; 'fan' = fan-invented) and 'source' (citation URL). Provenance is independent of how certain/identified a sign is.

orientationConventions.inward: pointed/shorter side facing the glyph's center
orientationConventions.note: A sign's rotation relative to the center often controls the DIRECTION of the effect (see Direction, Pull, Levitation).

signs.name: Column
signs.effect: Makes the magic manifest as a column/beam above the glyph. If signs are unbalanced, it manifests toward the side with more/larger signs. The shorter line usually faces outward.
signs.invertedEffect: Inverted variant seen in Wind Wall/Crystal Shard (column 'inward' / containment and eruption).
signs.placement: pairs or a ring around the sigil

thrust.note: Stem length projected onto the facing direction, normalised by ring radius. A long stem pushes harder; a wide base pushes less. (SPEC-magnitude-and-variants.md Layer 2)

signs.name: Dispersion
signs.effect: Makes the magic 'leak'/disperse out on all sides, like an overflowing bucket. It is essentially a column that leaks instead of firing.
signs.reference: signs.md, Bird of Light Beacon, Water Pen

signs.name: Levitation
signs.effect: Makes the magic (or the object it's drawn on) float above the glyph. If it moves an object, the direction follows where the signs point. The arrow tip usually faces inward.
signs.reference: signs.md, Pyreball Seal, Skysoaring Seal, Rising Platform of Water

signs.name: Pull
signs.effect: Pulls whatever shares its element (water, air, fire...) toward the glyph when the arrow points inward. Angled signs create a vortex/twist. Inverted = pushes.

signs.name: Crush
signs.effect: Disintegrates objects into dust (with an earth sigil). Inverted, it reassembles/reintegrates (temporarily).

signs.name: Float
signs.effect: Makes the object it's drawn on float in midair, regardless of gravity. More limited function than levitation after the retcon.

signs.name: Region
signs.effect: Controls the direction of the effect. All forward => fires forward; all inward => fires up; all outward => spreads out. Opposed pairs (pointing at each other) => magic only emerges from the space between them.
signs.reference: signs.md, Water Bolt, Floating Drops, Rising Wave

signs.name: Convergence
signs.effect: Focuses/concentrates the magic into a single point. Also stiffens and compacts loose particles (e.g. hardened sand). One point of the triangle faces inward.
signs.reference: signs.md, Sylph Shoes Seal, Serpent's Bed of Sand, Wind Wall

signs.name: Diamond
signs.effect: Likely effect: makes the glyph affect NEARBY objects (not the object it's drawn on). Direct substitute for window in Spell of Reduction vs Floating Expansion.

signs.name: Window
signs.effect: Likely effect: makes the glyph affect ONLY the object it's drawn on. Direct substitute for diamond in Floating Expansion.

signs.name: Collection
signs.effect: Collects material (and possibly magic) above/around the glyph for the spell to use. The open side usually faces inward.
signs.reference: signs.md, Billowing Collection, Serpent's Bed of Sand

signs.name: Crosshair
signs.effect: A component of the rainflinger glyph. Likely functions: making things of the same magic aspect disappear, or confining the manifestation to an area of effect.

signs.name: Radial
signs.effect: Decreases the spell's power — converts intense energy into a milder form (e.g. fire into heat).

signs.name: Bolt
signs.effect: Makes the sigil's magic manifest as bolts/projectiles. With a direction sign, it fires projectiles at high speed.

signs.name: Billow
signs.effect: Converts material into a fluffy cloud (comfortable to sit on). Needs collection to gather the material. Can occupy the center as a sigil.
signs.reference: signs.md, Billowing Collection, Serpent's Bed of Sand

signs.name: Eye
signs.effect: Light/shadow manipulation. With vision and bend, it melds the object (and what it covers) into the shadows. Currently indistinguishable from bend.

signs.name: Repetition
signs.effect: Resets objects to a previous state (rewinds time): keeps food fresh, cleans clothes, etc. Can occupy the center as a sigil.
signs.reference: signs.md, Repetition Seal, Magic Cookpot, Washing Barrels

signs.name: Vision
signs.effect: Light manipulation. With eye and bend, it helps make objects invisible. Needs no sigil — it occupies the center.

signs.name: Weave
signs.effect: Turns solid objects into long, flexible ribbons on contact. Invented by Richeh. Must encircle the central sigil.
signs.reference: signs.md, Boulder Stretch Rope, Crystal Ribbon

signs.name: Enlarge
signs.effect: Grows (corners pointing outward) or shrinks (corners pointing inward) objects. Combines with diamond (nearby object) or window (the object itself). Sits at the center if used alone.
signs.reference: signs.md, Floating Expansion, Spell of Reduction

signs.name: Rain
signs.effect: Generates the spell's magic as rainfall over the immediate area. Must encircle the central sigil (which sits in the empty middle).

signs.name: Puppet
signs.effect: Makes objects touched by the glyph (or the glyph itself) dart erratically through the air (with a wind sigil). The central sigil sits in the empty middle.
signs.reference: signs.md, Flying Puppet of Diversion, Cloak Spell

signs.name: Sights Set
signs.officialNameSource: WHA World Guide 2026 (MAGs preview, p.147); JP 'aiming vector' = set/lock a target
signs.effect: Aims a spell at a chosen point or target; appears to be mind-directed. Most likely directional/semi-directional.

signs.name: Gather
signs.effect: Actively draws in surrounding material for the spell to use (a more active counterpart to Collection).

signs.name: Strengthen
signs.officialNameSource: WHA World Guide 2026 (MAGs preview, p.147); JP 'reinforcement vector' — note the JP leans 'reinforce/empower' and may strengthen effects, not only physical durability
signs.effect: Presumably makes objects stronger and more durable. Most likely semi-directional; never seen inverted.

signs.name: Entwine
signs.officialNameSource: WHA World Guide 2026 (MAGs preview, p.147); JP 'coiling vector' — directs the effect to wrap/coil around something
signs.effect: Makes the object it is drawn on (e.g. a ribbon) wrap or "entwine" around other objects.

signs.name: Aeriforms Defined
signs.effect: An air modifier sharing the wind sigil’s design; can modify the wind underfoot sigil. Exact function unclear.

signs.name: Glaives
signs.effect: Determines how deeply magic embeds itself into an animal’s flesh. Pre-Pact; possibly not classified as a sign.

signs.name: Bind
signs.officialNameSource: WHA World Guide 2026 (MAGs preview, p.147); JP 'holding vector' — fixes/anchors the effect in place
signs.effect: Likely adheres like glue to the surface it touches, or holds an object together so it does not break apart.

signs.name: Link
signs.effect: Links its magic between the object it is drawn on and all others made from the same original object.

signs.name: Cool
signs.effect: Presumably cools things down. Featured in the Vapor Bubble spell.

signs.name: Orb
signs.effect: Creates a spherical space above the glyph in which controlled material collects, filling bottom-to-top.

signs.name: Sign of Wind
signs.effect: Asymmetrical wind sign that once served as a wind sigil. Its general function is unclear, but in Spiraling Flame, Agott names it a 'whirlwind keystone' — there it sets the column of flame spinning into a spiral. Treat its role as 'whirlwind / spin' where canon supports it, and 'unclear' otherwise (e.g. as a wind sigil in the Pegasus Carriage Spell).

signs.name: Purify
signs.effect: Separates impurities out of the element (particulates from water, dust from air); they gather near the spell.

signs.name: Solidification
signs.officialNameSource: WHA World Guide 2026 (MAGs preview, p.147 — Raincleaver); JP 'solidification vector' — causes the effect to harden/coagulate
signs.source: WHA World Guide 2026 (official MAGs preview), seen in the Raincleaver. Mechanic theorized; see docs/world-guide-2026.md.
signs.effect: Newly-named canon sign (World Guide 2026). Causes the spell's effect to harden / coagulate into a solid form. Exact behaviour pending the full guide; appears in the Raincleaver and Sand Bridge. Theory: distinct from Convergence (which focuses/compacts) — Solidification fixes a state as solid.

signs.name: Envelop
signs.officialNameSource: WHA World Guide 2026 (MAGs preview, p.147 — Raincleaver); JP 'cloaking vector' — clads/wraps the effect around like a garment
signs.source: WHA World Guide 2026 (official MAGs preview), seen in the Raincleaver. Mechanic theorized; see docs/world-guide-2026.md.
signs.effect: Newly-named canon sign (World Guide 2026). Clads / wraps the effect around its target like a garment (a 'cloaking' vector). In the Raincleaver, theorized to wrap the conjured water around the sword's edge. Exact behaviour pending the full guide.
